name: One&Only Portonovi, Montenegro
insider_take: Montenegro's first ultra-luxury resort sits on a pristine peninsula where the Adriatic meets dramatic mountains, offering exclusive access to one of Europe's most unspoiled coastal paradises.
whats_special: This stunning resort occupies the southern tip of the Luštica Peninsula in UNESCO-protected Boka Bay, often called Europe's southernmost fjord. The property features Montenegro's largest spa and sits within the exclusive Portonovi village, complete with a superyacht marina that attracts some of the world's most impressive vessels.
pro_tip: Book a sunset helicopter tour over Boka Bay - the resort's helipad makes it seamless, and the aerial views of the dramatic coastline and medieval towns like Kotor are absolutely breathtaking.
dont_miss: The resort's private beach club with crystal-clear waters perfect for snorkeling, and a short boat trip to the mystical Our Lady of the Rocks island - an artificial island built by local seamen over centuries, housing a stunning baroque church filled with maritime treasures.
pros: Stunning Boka Bay Setting — Nestled along the dramatic shores of Montenegro's Boka Bay, the resort offers breathtaking Adriatic views and direct waterfront access in a truly one-of-a-kind natural setting.

World-Class Spa & Wellness — Home to the renowned Chenot Espace wellness center, guests enjoy cutting-edge longevity treatments, thermal facilities, and holistic health programs unmatched in the region.
Exceptional Dining Experiences — Multiple award-winning restaurants showcase the finest Mediterranean and local Montenegrin cuisine, with alfresco waterfront dining that elevates every meal.

Luxurious Accommodations & Private Pool Villas — Elegantly appointed rooms, suites, and exclusive pool villas deliver refined comfort with stunning bay or garden views and impeccable attention to detail.

Private Marina & Yacht Access — A state-of-the-art private marina allows guests to arrive by sea and explore the Adriatic coastline with ease, adding a truly glamorous dimension to the resort experience.
cons: Secluded Location — Situated in the Herceg Novi Riviera, the resort is relatively remote from major international airports, requiring longer travel times that may not suit all itineraries.
Ultra-Premium Pricing — As a flagship luxury resort, rates and on-site experiences reflect a top-tier price point that may be beyond reach for budget-conscious travelers.
